gessq.logLevel.description: Verbosity of the GESS Q. Output channel ('GESS Q.').

gessq.debugMode.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: use 'gessq.logLevel' instead. When set, this is treated as logLevel = debug.
gessq.debugMode.description: Deprecated. Enable debug logging (equivalent to gessq.logLevel = debug).

gessq.diagnostics.enable.description: Report unbalanced brackets, unmatched #macro/#ifdef, missing #include files, duplicate names and unknown #domacro targets.

gessq.hover.enable.description: Show the GESS Q. hover (glossary description for keywords, and the definition location plus code preview for workspace names). Turn off to suppress the GESS Q. hover entirely.

enumDescriptions: No hover when pointing at a reference to a workspace name (keyword hovers still work).
Name, kind, definition location and the command's one-line description plus handbook link. No code.
Also an excerpt of the definition: the question line plus text / title / labels / flt / assert …, without actionblock / javascript / css attributes.
The complete definition verbatim, including actionblock / javascript / css.
gessq.hover.referenceDetail.description: How much a hover shows when pointing at a reference to a question or variable defined in the workspace. Requires 'gessq.hover.enable'.

gessq.codeLens.enable.description: Show the "N references" CodeLens above every definition. Turn off to hide the reference-count text.

gessq.completion.includeWorkspaceSymbols.description: Offer names defined elsewhere in the workspace (questions, blocks, macros, …) as completions.

gessq.files.exclude.description: Additional glob pattern excluded from the workspace symbol scan, e.g. "**/backup/**".

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.package: npm run check && node esbuild.js --production && vsce package
